name: Wrathful Dinosaur AP OLD
description: This figurine of a charging triceratops was crafted from the dinosaur's femur and contains its spirit.
disable: DC 24 Nature (expert) to banish the dinosaur's spirit with a primal incantation, DC 28 Intimidation to scare it off with a frightening display, or DC 26 Survival (expert) to calm the spirit

generalAbilities.name: Triceratops Trample
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the figurine

Effect A spectral triceratops appears around the figurine and charges toward the triggering creature, affecting a line 30 feet long. Creatures in this area take (4d10+22) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw).
